desc:
🌈 Cute game where you open boxes to get Chibi Pets!

How to Play:
🎲 Unbox cute Chibi Pets
🐾 Equip pets and have them follow you
💰 Earn coins, even while offline
🧬 Combine and upgrade your pets
🎯 Complete quests and earn rewards
🎡 Spin the wheel for BIG boosts
🧪 Use potions and upgrades to progress faster
🌍 Unlock new regions and better boxes
🔄 Rebirth for permanent boosts
📖 Complete your Pet Index

✨ Find shiny, lucky, giant and other rare mutations!
